text:
incident-bot: 🚨 routing-policy alert: policy=cost_prioritizer, metric=quality_regression, threshold=0.1, current=0.18. Rapid shift -> variant=gptx-lite-8q-cheap (70% traffic). Paging oncall. thread_ts=1987654321

Anne (oncall): got the page, looking now. any immediate customer reports?

Elena (support): multiple tickets flagged last 20m, some urgent customers reporting hallucinations and truncated answers. linking two threads: https://support/internal/ticket/4512 and /4539.

Raj (sre): I can see routing logs. cost_prioritizer rollout at 2026-03-15T14:02:00Z changed weight for cheapest_variant from 10% -> 70% due to a new autoscale heuristic. Error rate of policy_fallback up 4x.

Maya (ml): Quality monitor shows eval-set BLEU/ROUGE drop and a bump in toxicity/incorrect-entity rates for gptx-lite-8q-cheap vs baseline. This matches tickets.

Tim (engops): can we throttle the policy or flip to previous config? I can push a quick patch.

Anne (oncall): Raj, please take lead on immediate mitigation. Maya, prepare model pin recommendations. Tim, ready for a rollback. Elena, start running customer impact triage. Jordan, stand by for comms.

Raj (sre): on it. running quick check to confirm the policy id and commit: 

```
# fetch policy
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $INFRATOKEN" \
  https://control.redwood/internal/routing/policies/cost_prioritizer | jq '.'
```

Raj (sre): confirmed policy commit 3a7f09d linked to recent deploy by deploy-bot at 2026-03-15T14:01:40Z. It included a new `aggressiveness` param defaulting to 0.9. That explains the sudden weight shift.

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-15T14:01:40Z completed: infra/route-configs@3a7f09d by tim.

Tim (engops): I'm rolling a hotfix to revert aggressiveness -> 0.2 and pin cheapest_variant weight to 15%. Pushing now.

Tim (engops): executing rollback command: 

```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $INFRATOKEN" \
  -d '{"policy":"cost_prioritizer","patch":{"aggressiveness":0.2,"weights":{"gptx-lite-8q-cheap":0.15}}}' \
  https://control.redwood/internal/routing/policies/patch
```

Raj (sre): I see weights beginning to shift back. health checks for premium variants are green. request distribution trending back to baseline.

Maya (ml): recommend immediate pinning of the production traffic for high-value customers to `gptx-base-16b` until we finish a full QA on the quantized cheap variant. we should also add a quality gate on the policy for future auto-adjusts.

Anne (oncall): Lia, can you identify 10 most impacted customers and coordinate temporary pinning?

Lia (customer-ops): on it. Starting with enterprise accounts flagged in support tickets. Lia -> Elena: want me to open escalation threads for each?

Elena (support): yes, open escalations and offer targeted workaround: pin to premium variant and enable request-level fallback. I'll draft templated message.

Jordan (product): flagging SLA risk. Need a post-incident decision: disable cost_prioritizer autoscale until we have quality gating. Also want timeline for root cause analysis.

Anne (oncall): agreed. For live mitigation: 1) rollback policy aggressiveness (done), 2) temporarily disable automatic cost-driven weight changes, 3) pin risky customers to baseline model, 4) create rollback route in case of region failover.

Raj (sre): adding immediate firewall: circuit-break incoming weight changes from the policy engine for next 2h. 

Tim (engops): applied circuit-break: 

```
POST /internal/routing/controls/circuit-break
{"policy":"cost_prioritizer","duration":"2h","reason":"manual mitigation - quality regression"}
```

Tim (engops): verified via /internal/routing/stats that cost_prioritizer adjustments = 0 for 30s.

Maya (ml): starting a deeper regression test: run eval harness on recent production prompts vs gptx-lite-8q-cheap and baseline. ETA 90m. Will post diffs.

Elena (support): customer communications sent to 7/9 flagged accounts offering pin+credit. Lia, will you follow up on the two big enterprise CSMs now.

Lia (customer-ops): looped in CSMs. One asks for full traffic pin, approved by legal. Doing the change now.

Anne (oncall): handing off to Raj for the next 2h. I'll remain available if escalation to execs needed. Raj, capture mitigation steps and timeline for postmortem.

Raj (sre): taking over. Current status: weights back to baseline (~12% cheap var), circuit-break in place, targeted pins applied for priority customers, support comms sent. Monitoring quality signals and error rates.

Maya (ml): initial evals show gptx-lite-8q-cheap has 18% drop on our core QA prompt set vs baseline. Root cause likely quantization + decoder truncation under certain tokenization patterns. Will file an ML action item.

Tim (engops): we've also added a temporary metric alert: if policy causes >10pp quality delta -> auto-disable. We'll track and make permanent if useful.

Jordan (product): note for postmortem: decision timeline, why aggressiveness defaulted to 0.9 in that deploy, and why no quality gate prevented it. We need a plan for rollout gating for routing policies.

Anne (oncall): creating incident page now. Postmortem owner: Maya. ACTIONS:
- Tim: revert and add automated quality gate (todo/PR).
- Raj: assemble logs, timeframe, and mitigation timeline.
- Maya: root cause, fix for quantized variant + regression tests.
- Elena/Lia: customer comms follow-up.
- Jordan: product decisions on policy defaults.

Raj (sre): adding commands/log pointers for forensic: 
```
# routing change events
/grafana/dashboard/routing/changes?from=2026-03-15T13:50&to=2026-03-15T14:20
# model quality delta view
/kibana/app/discover?index=quality-*
```

Elena (support): one enterprise customer (ACME) requested immediate full pin for all calls; ACME CSM confirmed pin completed. They requested incident summary — Jordan, can we get a brief for them?

Jordan (product): drafting a one-paragraph summary for customers. Will post in channel when ready.

Anne (oncall): final status update before sign-off: mitigations applied, quality trend improving, no new high-severity tickets in last 12m. Keeping circuit-break for 2h. Next update in 30m or earlier if anything changes.

Raj (sre): monitoring. If metrics remain stable at next check I'll note time of mitigation closure.

Maya (ml): filing ML follow-up ticket: ML-987 (investigate quantization truncation + add QA harness and per-variant release checklist).

Elena (support): closing this slack thread for live mitigation. Please continue postmortem work in the incident doc (link to be posted). Thanks all for quick response :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: incident note appended to 1987654321: mitigations applied and policy reverted.
